:::{#hero-heading}
Hi,

I'm a PhD student in Sociology at the Department of Sociology, LMU Munich. My research focuses on property relations and wealth inequality, which I study using quantitative and computational methods. Currently, I focus on the ownership of knowledge and data in the context of wealth inequality.

:::
